source: Ma & Zhong (2003) JFM 488:31-78, §6 / Fig. 15 (M=4.5 neutral curves, omega vs R, 1st & 2nd mode)

conditions.length_scale: L* = sqrt(nu_e x / U_e); R = sqrt(Re_x); omega = R*F

quantity: full neutral curves omega(R) for 1st and 2nd mode (Fig. 15); 2nd-mode branch points at F=2.2e-4 anchored to the R=806/999.6 quoted in §6

metrics.headline: 2nd-mode neutral band matches Fig.15 across full omega-R range (branch I/II 3.1%/3.4% at F=2.2e-4, anchors 806/999.6); 1st-mode cutoff branch tracks, onset partial
metrics.full_curve: pyMack neg_alpha_i=0 contour traced over R=357-2000 (2nd mode) and 450-2000 (1st mode); 2nd-mode band edges match digitized Fig.15 to ~3-5% in omega; F=2.2e-4 crosses pyMack band at R~830/1000

verdict_reason: Upgraded from a 2-point check to a FULL neutral-curve comparison. pyMack traces both modes by sweeping (R, omega) and extracting the neg_alpha_i=0 contour. SECOND mode: pyMack reproduces the closed neutral band of Fig.15 across the whole range (nose ~R 280, upper branch ~0.225, lower branch ~0.18) matching the digitized curve to ~3-5% in omega; the F=2.2e-4 line crosses pyMacks band at R~831 (branch I, vs Ma&Zhong 806, 3.1%) and ~1033 (branch II, vs 999.6, 3.4%). FIRST mode: the cutoff (upper) branch tracks Fig.15 well; the low-omega onset (lower) branch is only partially resolved (same onset limitation as the Ozgen cases). Conditions verified vs the Ma&Zhong PDF (M=4.5, T_edge=65.15 K, unit Re=7.2e6/m, Sutherland S=110.33, Pr=0.72, adiabatic). Verdict acceptable: dominant 2nd-mode neutral curve matches across the full range; 1st-mode onset partial.
pymack_provenance: verification/neutralCurve_verification/mazhong2003_m4p5/compute_mazhong_m4p5.py (this session, 2026-06). CompressibleBlasius adiabatic M=4.5 base flow (Sutherland, S=110.33 K, Pr=0.72, gamma=1.4) at T_edge=65.15 K; solve_spatial with length_scale='L_star', lambda_mu_ratio=1.2, N=130, y_max=40; fixed F=2.2e-4 (omega=R*F); coarse R-sweep 700-1100 then bisection on -alpha_i=0 for the two second-mode neutral crossings. Same M=4.5 base-flow setup as the CI-gated Malik (1990) Case-6 anchor (validation/test_malik1990_case6_anchor.py). Reference values read directly from the Ma & Zhong (2003) PDF (sec. 6: 'interval from R = 806 (branch I neutral stability point) to 999.6 (branch II neutral stability point)').
